faq.q: What does TESERACT Creative Studios do?
faq.a: TESERACT is a digital creative studio focused on design, technology and experiences. We create interactive, thoughtful and tailor-made digital experiences for businesses that want to be different.
Remotely, with businesses, founders and teams across India and worldwide.

faq.q: Do I need a perfect brief before we talk?
faq.a: No. You don't need a perfect brief. You don't need technical knowledge. You don't even need to know exactly what you want yet. Tell us what you have in mind — we'll take it from there.
We don't believe in fixed packages. Every business has different goals, audiences and challenges, so we build what makes sense for you.

faq.q: What can you build for us?
faq.a: Website design, website development, e-commerce, interactive & 3D experiences, brand & digital identity, product & SaaS, AI & automation and digital strategy.
Yes. From discovering a product to completing a purchase, we design every step of the experience: product pages, shopping experiences, cart & checkout, payment integration and order management.

faq.q: Do you design SaaS products and landing pages?
faq.a: Yes. We design dashboards, SaaS platforms, web applications, user flows and prototypes, and we build landing pages.

faq.q: Will my website look like a template?
faq.a: No. You don't need another template. Every project starts from zero, built around your business, your audience and your vision.
Understand, define, explore, design, refine, build, test, launch and evolve. We take the time to understand, explore, design, build and refine.
Launch is not the end. Businesses change, and your website should be able to change with them. We can continue supporting, improving and evolving your digital experience as your business grows.
We communicate, share progress, ask questions, listen to feedback and build together — because the best results happen when the client isn't just watching the process. They're part of it.

faq.q: What does the name TESERACT mean?
faq.a: Tesseract is a geometric concept associated with a fourth dimension. For the agency, the name represents thinking beyond the obvious, exploring new dimensions of digital experiences, and building work that goes beyond ordinary websites.

founder.label: The person behind TESERACT
founder.name: Gireesh
founder.quote: Great design doesn't just look different. It makes people experience something differently.
body: With nearly five years of professional experience across aviation, business, technology and digital innovation, Gireesh brings together a multidisciplinary perspective shaped by different industries and disciplines.

His journey began in aviation, followed by a transition into business and strategy, before moving into technology and ultimately product design. Today, he focuses on Product Design, UI/UX and interactive digital experiences, combining business thinking with design to turn complex ideas into products that are clear, intuitive and purposeful.

Over the years, Gireesh has worked across diverse digital projects, exploring the relationship between people, business and technology. His work has also extended into innovation challenges and hackathons, including a first-place hackathon achievement.

title: We could tell you we're different.

work.body: Explore a selection of work we've created for businesses, brands and digital products.

projects.sum: A single-page website for Aivinci Creative Studio, an AI creative and technology studio, showing its AI films, creative technology and digital products.
A one-page website for Geetha Jewellers, a gold and diamond jewellery shop: scroll-animated collections, a store-visit section and gold savings schemes.
A travel booking website for AeroSkys to search and book flights, hotels, holiday packages and buses; a working prototype in which bookings are simulated.
An online menswear shop for Derlin Haus: shirts, T-shirts and trousers, with category pages, search and filters, size selection and a bag with coupons.
An online store for Mahira Select's Indian ethnic womenswear, from sarees and kurta sets to lehengas, with a cinematic home page, a cart and checkout.
A website for SAN Media Solution, a digital marketing agency: its services, marketing packages and team, and a work page of reels, films and posters.
An online saree boutique for SIAARA By S&A: handcrafted sarees by weave and colour, product pages, a wishlist, a bag and an English and Telugu switch.
A travel eSIM store for Vynk Network: compare plans by destination and get a QR-code eSIM; in this preview build, accounts, codes and payments are simulated.
A resume-builder website for LiveCV that turns a resume into one permanent live link, shown with example profiles the site labels illustrative.
A website for Hidden Stories, eight short-stay homes in Hyderabad: a scroll-driven story around a home-tour film, then search and booking in demo mode.
A careers site for Aeroskys, a travel booking company: open roles in three groups, each with its own page, career ladder, hiring process and application.
A concept landing page for Sagewell, an invented AI reasoning model for developers and teams, with a prompt composer and a reasoning-trace demo.
A concept landing page for Vantline, an invented decision-intelligence copilot that explains what changed in your numbers, shown with sample data.

projects.n: Not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta
projects.sum: A concept landing page for Tidings, an invented chat-commerce platform for small shops and restaurants, with clickable phone chats and a campaign builder.
A concept landing page for Emberpost, an invented people-first email app that files every email under its sender, with a clickable sample inbox.
A portfolio concept for Ines Morrow, a fictional film and commercial editor, with a scrubbable reel timeline and a before-and-after colour-grade slider.
A concept landing page for Maren Holt, a fictional developmental editor with a weekly newsletter: a keycap headline, sample essays, a reader and search.

projects.n: Unofficial, not affiliated with the rights holders
projects.sum: An unofficial fan tribute to Monkey D. Luffy, told in cinematic, scroll-driven chapters: a fan experiment made for fun and never sold.
A concept store for TĀVRA, a women's sportswear concept built on Indian textile crafts such as bandhani, ikat and ajrakh; checkout and payment are off.
A concept website for VELORA, a fragrance-house concept built around its signature eau de parfum, with an interactive bottle and notes; ordering is not open.
An editorial concept website for AARADHYA, a saree-house concept themed around Maa Durga: a love letter to the saree, to heritage and to the feminine spirit.
A concept website for SAANJH, a drinks-brand concept of bottled Indian-flavoured blends in three flavours: Kesar Cloud, Elaichi Silk and Gulab Velvet.
A fashion storefront concept for VYRN, a concept label of modern essentials, with animated editorial sections, a collection and product pages; payments are off.
A concept storefront for Vesper, an architectural-lighting brand concept: a shop, four collections and a day/night mode; no real orders are processed.
A one-page personal site for Gireesh: a portrait hero, an about statement, the kinds of digital work he offers to build and a meeting request.
A one-page brand-concept website for THENGA, a coconut-water concept: a scroll-driven 3D coconut cracks open to reveal the can, then five flavours.
A six-page personal UI/UX portfolio for Gireesh, styled as a designer's desk, with a work board, a process scene and illustrative case studies.
A concept 3D showroom and demo store for office chairs under the invented brand Sedile, with a Chair Finder, real-time 3D views and a demo checkout.
A single-page cinematic personal portfolio for Gireesh, built from WebGL and video scenes: a walk-out opening, a creative universe, a journey through time.

Technology creates possibilities. Design gives those possibilities meaning.
